decisions.reason: Expanding question curation to additions and rewording does not alter the answer-layer rules; the candidate's separate same-message MODIFY already captures the directly stated layer structure and applicable contexts.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures the category- and chapter-level merge, removal, and addition recommendations, so no additional propagated change is required.
Curation of questions in existing chapters or categories does not change the subject, format, or question-count policy of this new chapter.
The expanded existing-question curation actions do not change this new chapter's first-time-leader focus, format, or question-count policy.
The source curation change concerns existing questions and does not alter the remote and hybrid chapter's subject, format, or question-count rule.
Adding and rewording existing questions does not change the AI preparation chapter's mandatory status, covered material, format, or length guidance.
The existing-question curation expansion does not alter the pre-interview chapter's audience, content guidance, format, or length.

The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already requires editorial review for additions and removals and discussion for other revisions, covering the newly permitted curation recommendations without further modification.
The goal of reflecting current workplace questions does not necessarily modify the separately defined international perspective, markets, or integration approach.
The source expands permissible curation recommendations but does not specify a new editing procedure for additions or rewording or change the established Google Doc removal workflow.
Question-set curation actions do not change the companion-resource deliverables, resource types, learning purpose, or delivery format.
The expanded curation actions do not change the existing 110,000-word ceiling or the recorded approximate length of the existing edition.
